'''Frewin Bromley''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a security guard for the [[Black Sun sector chief|sector chief]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], [[Avrak Villachor]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]]. He was offered a bribe by a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], but due to his loyalty to Black Sun, he refused it and reported it to Villachor.<ref name="Scoundrels" />
